description: Bus Safety Information Network (BUSNET) Operator Report: Beginning 2009 is a dataset listed in State of New York open data portal (data.ny.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by State of New York. The Bus Safety Information Network (BUSNET) Profile Operator Report dataset provides a summary of annual bus passenger vehicle operators safety inspections conducted by New York State Department of Transportation (NYSDOT). Coverage: New York State. The portal files it under the category Transportation. Its tags are bus inspections, transportaion. The table has 7 columns. Attribution on the portal: New York State Department of Transportation (NYSDOT). The portal shows 2026-07-06 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-ny-gov-portal.
